m0-context.title: Load baseline context + verify handoff
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT, the g3 handoff, analysis_refresh.md, and the verified primitives (config schema, _resolve_eval_year_split, run_season_alignment, season aggregator, runbook scripts). Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: crew context + glossary + handoff loaded; handoff complete; primitives confirmed by reading
postconditions.satisfied_by: Read CREW/ORCH/GLOSSARY, g3 handoff, analysis_refresh.md, config schema, _resolve_eval_year_split, run_season_alignment, season aggregator, runbook scripts. Handoff complete: task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions/return-format all present.

m1-phase1-runner-wiring.title: Phase 1 — thread eval-year cutoff through the gold-cycle runner into training + eval range
m1-phase1-runner-wiring.imperative: TDD. Wire config.data.eval_year_train_through_round / eval_round_range from the MAIN train job (build_main_train_backtest_jobs -> _module_train_args) into cmd_train_latent_power_module -> prepare_module_training_data, restrict the MAIN backtest template + the sampled phase to eval_round_range, and load the eval-year compound prior in as-of-N mode (allow_same_season). LOSO/calibration jobs MUST NOT receive the cutoff. Keep gold defaults byte-for-byte unchanged. Prove via a spy/mock test asserting forwarded kwargs on real code (mock only NN training/solve).

postconditions.statement: cutoff config forwards eval_year_train_through_round=N / eval_round_range=(lo,hi) into prepare_module_training_data AND restricts eval/backtest to the range; gold path (cutoff unset) unchanged; tests pass

constraints: No loosening of G2 leakage semantics or the gold-mode guard

m2-walkforward-package.title: Phase 2 — src/evo_predictor/walkforward/ orchestrator (periods, per-period pipeline, aggregation, enforced attestation)
m2-walkforward-package.imperative: TDD. Create the walkforward package: the 4 periods (P0 reuse promoted gold R1-6; P1-3 cutoff pipeline = as-of-N prior build -> per-period research gold-cycle TOML with cutoff -> fusion -> materialize -> trained sampled-runtime predictions for the eval rounds), prediction collection (P0 from per_race_predictions; P1-3 from per_race[].prediction.position_distribution ranked by ascending mean position), aggregation via G1 SeasonAggregator against DB actuals, and an ENFORCED per-race leakage attestation (run FAILS if any race has train_max_round >= race round or a prior built through a round >= race round). Heavy gold/fusion/materialize/comparison calls are MOCKED in tests.

preconditions.satisfied_by: Phase 1 wiring complete and green (10 wiring tests + 141 regression)

postconditions.statement: orchestrator defines the 4 periods exactly; attestation correct + enforced (synthetic train>=race race FAILS); aggregation reuses G1; summary matches the output contract; heavy calls mocked; tests green

constraints: Reuse G1 aggregator + runbook scripts; do not reimplement fusion/materialize/comparison
Per-period priors/outputs isolated; never overwrite params/gold
Attestation must be real and enforced

m3-run-verify-scripts.title: Phase 2 — scripts/run_walkforward_backtest.py (+--dry-run/--utilization) and scripts/verify_walkforward_run.py
m3-run-verify-scripts.imperative: Add the run entrypoint (full run; --utilization passthrough; --dry-run prints the per-period plan WITHOUT executing) and the verify gate (exit 0 iff 24 races, period-attributed, attestation_all_pass; nonzero otherwise). Capture the real --dry-run plan output. Unit-test the verify gate's pass/fail logic.

preconditions.satisfied_by: walkforward package complete and green (34 tests)

postconditions.statement: --dry-run prints the per-period plan (periods, cutoff N, eval range, prior root, configs) with no execution; verify exits 0 on a valid 24-race attested summary and nonzero otherwise; tests green

constraints: verify is a real gate, not advisory

m4-simplification-and-regression.title: Simplification limits on touched paths + runner regression + dry-run evidence
m4-simplification-and-regression.imperative: Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits on the touched src/ + tests/ paths and the runner regression suite; capture the --dry-run plan. Confirm all required evidence commands are green.

postconditions.statement: simplification_limits passes on touched paths; runner regression suite green; dry-run plan captured
